name: Комбінація (2)
description:
We are back to combinations again. Do you remember what a combination is? In a combination you use several tactical concepts simultaneously. Sometimes you also temporarily sacrifice material, only to regain it with interest.

What do you have to do? 

Win material through a combination.

examples.text: White can win with a series of exchanges: 1.Nxf6+! exf6 2.Qxe8+! Bxe8 3.Rxe8#

examples.pgn: 24... Rxc6 {[%csl Rb8,Rc1,Gc6,Ge8,Rg1][%cal Gc6c1,Ge8b8]} 25. Qxc6 Qxb8 {[%csl Gb8]} *

texts: This wins a pawn, and moreover, White is now in a fork.
The white knight is a key defender.
Pawn gain is a nice step toward victory, plus you have a fork.
